pages.text: [#](53341a)The circle-working of buried fire made manifest. Where the land below hides a real lava pool, this rite drags that violence upward and forces the ground into a fresh volcano. Less control than a bargain with pressure and ruin.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Earth's Wrath

pages.text: [#](53341a)A large staged terrain rite through a **Lava Bucket** trigger; the ground below must hold a sizable lava pool or it fails. A nearby **Bound Waystone** can retarget the eruption.[#]() [#](53341a)The cone rises in pulses and opens its vent at the end.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)Use it to scar the land or make a place no traveler mistakes for safe.[#]()
